summary: BeyondSpring Inc. disclosed via Form 8-K that on September 30, 2026 it closed the Sale of 100% of BeyondSpring Ltd., a BVI wholly owned subsidiary indirectly holding Dalian Wanchunbulin Pharmaceuticals (Bulin), to Biolin Investment Limited of Hong Kong under a September 28, 2026 Share Purchase and Collaboration Agreement. Consideration is non-cash: the buyer must fund and complete the China portion of the global Phase 3 DUBLIN-4 plinabulin/docetaxel NSCLC trial, with BeyondSpring retaining access to that clinical data. No cash changed hands; no premium or per-share price applies. Pro forma financials were furnished, and no advisor or board recommendation was named. Watch trial execution, milestone/data-access terms, and any related-party issues.
